reader.requirement: At --std 85, when MERGE has a GIVING phrase, each file-name-4 bounds the sort-merge file's records: a variable-length file-name-4 refuses a file-name-1 whose smallest record is smaller than its smallest or whose largest is larger than its largest; a fixed-length file-name-4 refuses a file-name-1 record larger than its largest; every GIVING file is checked, fixed or variable as the 1985 RECORD clause and the implementor's choice (no RECORD clause, Format 3) make it.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (from 2002): whether Format 3's integer-4/integer-5 are the bounds (VaryingRecordInfo.BoundsEnforced); at 85 they are not, and VaryMin/VaryMax answer the record descriptions' own smallest and largest (§1985:VII.3.8.4 GR14 makes them the same sizes)

reader.edition-search: ScreenTransferRecordSizes reads no edition; grep for Edition.Edition|DialectLevel|DialectBehaviors|Year < in SortBinder.cs finds only RELEASE (line 517) and ScreenSameClauses (line 927), neither on this rule's path.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: for a Format 3 RECORD clause (CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5) the range compared is the record descriptions' at 85 and the integers from 2002; for Format 1, Format 2 and no clause, no difference

reader.notes: One screen compares the two files' RecordSizeRange for USING and GIVING alike; every GIVING file is visited. Fixed or variable for a file with no RECORD clause and for Format 3 is the implementor's choice at 85 (§1985:II.2.1.4.3), documented at DOC-A.1-147/148. The diagnostic cites the 2023 rule number (§2023:14.9.24.3 SR12) at --std 85, where the rule is SR11: the wording is right, the number is another edition's.
